species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 26–92 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 49°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 28–32 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.
